rv.q: The show is frequently close to fine, but not better.
"Starstruck" is a winning show...registers as a fully formed piece that is ready for Broadway today.
Starstruck is not a bad idea for a musical, but it will require heaps and heaps of work to bring it up to snuff.
The book by Malone and Stratton is well crafted with a strong story line and supporting characters that are appealing.

cn.t: This Cyrano-inspired musical featuring Indigo Girls' Emily Saliers receives mixed notices, with critics divided on whether its female romance and astronomy setting overcome a dreary execution.
